note: Lesson 6.3 (portfolio and templates) has no new n8n build: its solved problem packages your existing Boss 3 workflow as a sellable template.

walk.title: Solve it: Boss 3 as a sellable template
walk.sample: HL · Telegram order bot (Boss 3) · its proof-of-work log · a fresh n8n trial account

steps.say: We're turning the Telegram order bot into a package another shop can buy and set up in 15 minutes: workflow, sample sheet, README, video and case study.
show: 5 pieces: workflow · sheet · README · video · case study

steps.say: Duplicate the workflow and rename Harvest Lane things to neutral names, like Your shop.

Move every business setting, the delivery fee, the free-delivery threshold, the 50-unit limit and the owner's chat ID, into one Settings node at the start, so buyers change them in one place. Then add sticky notes.
Unpin all data. Pinned test data travels inside the file, and a buyer should never meet Funmi's order.
Any key typed into a field goes along with the export. Move it into a credential, run the file through the Card 4 checker, and fix what it finds at the source, not just in the file.
show: Export → Card 4 checker → fix at source

steps.say: Replace your sheet ID with a placeholder, then read the final file once yourself. Pattern checks don't catch everything.
Make a sample sheet with the four tabs, ten fake products and two fake customers, shared so anyone with the link can make a copy.
show: Sharing: anyone with the link can copy

steps.say: Test on a fresh account: a new n8n trial, a new Telegram test bot and a copy of the sheet. Follow only the README, and time yourself.
show: New n8n Cloud trial (or fresh Docker volume)
New Telegram test bot · copy of the sheet

steps.say: Every time you have to look something up, that answer goes into the README. Keep going until setup takes under 15 minutes.
show: Looked something up → fix the README

steps.say: Write the case study from your Boss 3 log: the problem, the build in plain words, how it's safe, and the results, labelled honestly as test results for a fictional business.
show: Problem: pricing orders by hand at night
Safety: prices never from AI; big orders to a human

steps.say: Then record the three-minute demo: the problem from the customer's side, the solution on the phone, one safety feature, and the numbers. Use test data, and hide tokens and other tabs.
show: Test data only; hide email and tokens

walk.end: That's the package: a clean file with no secrets or pinned records, a copyable sheet, a README tested on a fresh account, an honest case study and a three-minute demo.
